name: Minimal Composer
description: A one-line prompt field that grows only when needed: @ files and / commands open at the caret, Enter sends, and Send becomes Stop while a reply runs.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Shown while the field is empty.

props.name: state
props.description: Controlled state. Leave it out and the composer owns the state and simulates the reply.

props.name: onStateChange
props.description: Fires on send (generating) and on Stop (idle). Required when you pass state, because the host ends the reply.

props.name: onSubmit
props.description: Receives the trimmed message. Return a promise to keep generating until it settles.

props.name: onStop
props.description: Fires when Stop is pressed or Escape is pressed while generating.

props.name: replyMs
props.description: Uncontrolled only: how long a send keeps generating when onSubmit returns nothing.

props.name: files
props.type: { id: string; name: string; detail: string }[]
props.description: Files offered by the @ popover. Names have no spaces, because the mention is written as @name.

props.name: commandList
props.description: Commands offered by the / popover, which opens only at the start of a line.

props.name: mentions
props.description: Whether typing @ opens the file popover and shows the hint.

props.name: commands
props.description: Whether a / at the start of a line opens the command popover and shows the hint.

props.name: maxRows
props.description: Rows the field may grow to (1 to 10) before it scrolls inside itself.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one accent, used only for mention text. Defaults to amber on dark and rust on light.

props.name: theme
props.description: The surface the composer sits on, so its ink, borders and shadow keep their contrast.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes on the root, for width or margin.
